comportamentos: Model storing a professor's coordinated projects (Grant, table grants): missing — implemented as ProfessorProject/professor_projects
Fields title, start_year, end_year, kind, funder, amount: missing — uses title, year, financing_type, financier, total_value, and has no end_year
kind restricted to translated Público/Privado values (Grant::KINDS, PUBLIC, PRIVATE): differs — stores raw 'public'/'private' with FINANCING_TYPES

Validations (presence, amount >= 0, end_year >= start_year, professor cannot edit other professors' grants with cannot_edit_other_grants error): partial — no end_year check, and authorization is done through ability conditions instead of a model validation
Ability: professors can create Grant and update their own, with cannot :edit_professor: differs — uses a scoped manage on ProfessorProject and has no edit_professor ability
GrantsController with routes /grants, defaulting professor to the current user: differs — ProfessorProjectsController at /professor_projects
Navigation menu entry and pt-BR translations for grant: differs — keyed as professor_project
justificativa: The candidate does address the issue's feature, but it uses different model, table, route and column names (ProfessorProject/year/financing_type/financier/total_value instead of Grant/start_year/end_year/kind/funder/amount), so anything relying on the official names would not work.
